summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY with embedded software development experience across STM32, Arduino, Raspberry Pi and NVIDIA Jetson. Built bare-metal C firmware with interrupt-driven UART/I2C/SPI and FreeRTOS, and resolved 11 integration failures to reach 10/10 pick reliability. Hands-on with testing, troubleshooting and verification using oscilloscopes and logic analyzers.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove for hands-free cursor control integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and hardware/software integration end-to-end.
Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Built a Cortex-M4 temperature monitoring firmware in embedded C with timer-synchronized sensing and real-time display.
Implemented timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a low-level I2C driver.
Programmed peripherals directly in bare-metal C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1); achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at deterministic 1 Hz update rate; verified in Proteus.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture) across a Jetson, Arduino and sensor system; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.

Built a three-layer distributed system: Flutter mobile client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, and Jetson+Arduino controller linked by a WebSocket fabric; integrated dual VL53L0X ToF sensors via TCA9548A I2C mux for contact-aware grasping.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson to detect and track objects, sending control commands to STM32 over UART.
Implemented multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART commands and user override.
Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.

projects.name: Robocon Competition Robot — Holonomic Drive & Encoder Odometry
bullets: Implemented interrupt-driven quadrature decoding from first principles — a 4-bit A/B transition state machine on hardware interrupts — and drove four motor channels at 15 kHz PWM via DuePWM.

Integrated Xbox 360 control over USB Host Shield with 4x Cytron motor drivers, dual claw subsystems with per-claw IR sensing, and a catapult thrower; added a fail-safe state machine halting all motors on controller disconnect.
